It is a reminder that every person has the potential to be strong and powerful in the eyes of God, no matter what their circumstances may be. This spiritual significance is underscored by the hadith of the Prophet Muhammad, who said, "The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than a weak believer, and both are sisters of one another in this world and in the Hereafter."
